{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Replace -1 in customer_age with NaN (missing)
df['customer_age'] = df['customer_age'].replace(-1, pd.NA)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99
df = df[~qa_mask]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
completed_mask = df['status'] == 'completed'
df = df[completed_mask]

# Final dataset
print(f"Final dataset shape: {df.shape}")

# Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment: this is key
channel_segment_ct = pd.crosstab(df['channel'], df['customer_segment'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(channel_segment_ct)

# Check conversion rate by channel
conv_by_channel = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conv_by_channel)

# Check conversion rate by segment
conv_by_segment = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conv_by_segment)

# Now check conversion rate within each segment, by channel
# This is the correct way: stratify by segment
print("\nConversion rate by channel, within each segment:")
print(df.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean())"}
